v: na॰ samam ardDaBAgena tulyamudakaM yatra । ardDAmbu saMyogena maTitadaDijAte 1 takraBede hemaca॰ । saha modavena sahasya saH । 2 modakasahite trikARqaSezaH ।
m: समोदक mfn. containing the same quantity of water, L.
समोदक n. a mixture of half buttermilk and half water, L.
सम्-ओह m. hostile encounter, conflict, war, RV.
सम्-ओहम् ind. bringing or sweeping together, ib.
सम्-ओकस् mfn. living or dwelling together, closely united with (instr.), RV.; TBr.; Kauś.
(in rhet.) comparison expressed by सम in composition with the substantive to which an object is likened, MW.
सम्-ओपेत mfn. (for सम्-आ-उप्˚, √ 5. इ) furnished or endowed with, possessed of (comp.), MBh.; Pañcat.
सम्-ओप्त mfn. thrown in together, mixed, mingled, Lāṭy.
सम्-ओत mfn. woven or strung together, AV.
